## Documentation Map

This Quarto site follows the [Divio documentation system](https://docs.divio.com/documentation-system/), keeping four kinds of documentation separate:

- [Tutorials](./tutorials.qmd): learning-oriented lessons for a first successful path through the project.
- [How-to guides](./how-to.qmd): goal-oriented recipes for specific tasks.
- [Reference](./reference.qmd): information-oriented descriptions of commands, APIs, configuration, schemas, and generated assets.
- [Explanation](./explanation.qmd): understanding-oriented context, architecture, tradeoffs, and decisions.
